articles.title: What algorithm did Windows XP use to choose your initial user picture?
articles.summary: Windows XP used a one-pass random selection algorithm to choose the initial user picture, using the current value of GetTickCount as the initial seed. This approach is more efficient than a two-pass algorithm and avoids complications if the number of files in the directory changes while the code is running. The algorithm selects the last item in the directory with a 1/n chance of being randomly selected, where n is the number of items in the directory.
